dslRule:
<!id: add-null-check-for-completion-requestor>
<!description: Adds a null check for fCompletionContextRequestor before accessing its methods to prevent NPE. >
<!severity: ERROR>
$completionRequestor.getOriginalCu() == null :: instanceof($completionRequestor, "org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.refactoring.contentassist.ICompletionContextRequestor")
=>
$completionRequestor == null || $completionRequestor.getOriginalCu() == null
;;
summary: Adds a null check for `fCompletionContextRequestor` before dereferencing it to call `getOriginalCu()`, preventing a NullPointerException if the field itself is null.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
